Insert equation

Use shorthand, symbols, formula templates, a keypad, or direct LaTeX.

Shorthand example: 'I_D = (mu_n C_ox)/2 W/L (V_GS - V_T)^2'. Direct LaTeX example: $I_D=\frac{1}{2}\mu_n C_{ox}\frac{W}{L}(V_{GS}-V_T)^2$. Plain prose stays upright. Semiconductor expressions such as N_A=10^17 cm^-3, N_A x_p=N_D x_n, E_max≈q N_D x_n/ε_s, and V_bi are detected automatically. Use delimiters when you want exact manual control. Computer Modern Roman is available in the font menus. The inserted result remains editable and exports as vector SVG.

Solid-State Electronics Templates

Insert polished, editable template drawings for lecture notes, labs, homework sets, and slides.

Select canvas objects to register a template.
Select any finished canvas objects and choose Save selected drawing, or right-click a selected object and choose Save as solid-state template. Import file as template accepts PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, BMP, SVG, EE Canvas project JSON, and exported template-library JSON. Images and SVG are embedded so the registered template remains reusable in this browser.

Save selected drawing as template

Only the currently selected canvas objects are captured. The drawing is normalized and stored in this browser. Images are embedded when possible.

Manage solid-state templates

Rename templates, edit descriptions, assign or create categories, and remove items you no longer need.

Template categories

Create your own category names. Built-in categories remain available.

Templates

Edit metadata without replacing the drawing.
Deleting a custom category moves its templates to Custom. Built-in templates can be hidden and restored.

⠿Optimize line or energy-band curve

Smooth accidental kinks, level unwanted tilt, or rebuild a physically clean band-bending transition. Existing endpoint connections remain attached.

Recommended workflow: 1) choose a quick setting or preset, 2) adjust the core sliders, 3) open Physics or Linked bands only when needed, and 4) refine points directly in the live preview.

Live orientation
No partial range selected. Choose Select curve area, then drag across the preview or Shift-click two control points.
Use the orientation buttons to rotate, level, or flip the whole curve—or only the orange selected range—with immediate preview. Drag points normally. For partial editing, choose Select curve area and drag a rectangle over part of the curve, or Shift-click the first and last control points. Then smooth only that area or convert it to straight/step segments without changing the rest.
